Name: Moody Farmer - Immersive Daily Mood System
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Moody Farmer[/b][/size][/center]
[left][/left]
[center][size=2][b]Give your farmer a little personality — because not every day is a good day.[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Ever wake up in Stardew Valley and think, [i]“I wonder what kind of mood my farmer is in today?”[/i][/size][/center]

[center][size=2][b]Moody Farmer[/b] adds a daily mood system that gives your farmer a random mood each morning. Some days you’ll feel fantastic, some days you’ll want to stay in bed, and some days… you’d really rather not talk to anyone.[/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Each mood comes with its own gameplay effect, and some negative moods can be overcome by changing how you spend your day.[/size][/center]

[center][size=2]With [b]Version 4.0.0[/b], Moody Farmer introduces the [b]Positive Moods Expansion[/b], adding four completely new moods and a new recovery rhythm where a bad day is followed by something better.[/size][/center]

[left][size=3][b]🌱 The Moods[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]There are [b]7 possible moods[/b]:[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]😊 [b]Happy[/b] — Your having a great day![/size][/left]
[left][size=2]😐 [b]Neutral[/b] — Just another normal Stardew day.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]😢 [b]Sad[/b] — Today isn’t feeling great.. Spend the day talking to villagers to shake it off.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]😴 [b]Bored[/b] —Everything feels a little too familiar. Visit different areas around the valley to get out of the rut.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]🛌 [b]Lazy[/b] — Maybe today is a good day to take it easy. You simply don’t feel like doing much today.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]🙃 [b]Antisocial[/b] — People? No thanks.  (Talking to villagers costs stamina).[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]💜 [b]Depression[/b] — When Sad isn’t dealt with, things can get worse.[/size][/left]
[left][size=2]😰 [b]Stressed[/b] — Some days, everything just feels like a bit too much.[/size][/left]

[left][b][size=3]And now in Version 4.0.0:[/size]
[size=2]🤩 Excited — Full of adrenaline and ready to move.
🔥 Motivated — You’ve got the energy to get things done.
😏 Confident — You’re feeling capable and ready for a fight.
🥰 Affectionate — You’re feeling especially warm toward the people around you.[/size][/b][/left]

[left][b][size=3]🎨 Cute Mood Icons[/size][/b][/left]
[left]Your current mood is displayed as a small cute icon above the stamina bar, so you can quickly see how your farmer is feeling without opening a menu.[/left]
[left]Each mood has its own icon.[/left]

[left][size=3][b]🔄 Bad Day → Good Day[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]Negative moods have one important rule:[/size][/left]
[left][size=2][b]If you get a negative mood, the following day is guaranteed to be Happy.[/b][/size][/left]
[left][size=2]This guarantee remains even if you manage to remove the negative mood early.[/size][/left]

[left][b][size=3]💜 Depression[/size][/b][/left]
[left]If you wake up [b]Sad[/b] and don’t overcome it during the day, the sadness can become [b]Depression[/b] the following morning.[/left]
[left]Depression is a more serious mood that comes with stronger penalties and two ghosts that follow your farmer around.[/left]
[left]The ghosts:[/left]
[left]·       Follow you indoors and outdoors[/left]
[left]·       Follow you between locations[/left]
[left]·       Cannot be killed[/left]
[left]·       Teleport away when hit and slowly return[/left]
[left]·       Deal damage when they catch you[/left]
[left]·       Disappear once Depression is cured[/left]
[left]They’re there as a reminder that your farmer needs to take a break.[/left]

[left][b]🚌 Take a Break[/b][/left]
[left]The way to clear Depression is to [b]go home[/b].[/left]
[left]While depressed, visit the [b]Bus Stop[/b] to choose whether to visit your hometown.[/left]
[left]Taking the trip clears Depression, removes the anxiety ghosts in your mind, and gives your farmer a much-needed break.[/left]

[left][b]🤯 Stressed[/b] is a deeper, more interactive mood than the original Moody Farmer moods.[/left]
[left]Your farmer can simply wake up feeling stressed.[/left]
[left]While Stressed, your farmer has a hidden [b]Relief[/b] level. There’s no progress bar, no quest checklist, and no numbers constantly appearing on screen.[/left]
[left]Instead, you naturally work through the mood by simply playing the game.[/left]
[left]Things that can help relieve stress include:[/left]
[left][list]
[*]Talking to close friends[/*]
[*]Spending time with your spouse or partner[/*]
[*]Interacting with your pets[/*]
[*]Fishing[/*]
[*]Defeating monsters[/*]
[*]Relaxing at the Stardrop Saloon[/*]
[*]Spending some time at the Beach[/*]
[/list]As your farmer begins to feel better, the [b]Stressed mood icon changes colour[/b]:[/left]
[left][b]Red → Purple → Normal Skin Tone → Neutral[/b][/left]
[left]At high stress, tool actions that already use stamina cost a little more energy. As the farmer relaxes, that extra cost gradually disappears.[/left]
[left]Talking to villagers you aren’t close with while Stressed can also make your farmer a little short-tempered, causing a small friendship penalty.[/left]
[left]But there’s no punishment for failing to completely overcome Stressed.[/left]
[left]If the day ends while you’re still stressed, that’s okay.[/left]
[left][b]A stressful day is just a stressful day. Nothing more, nothing less.[/b][/left]

[left][b][size=3]❤️ Why Moody Farmer?[/size][/b][/left]
[left]Not every day is going to be a good day.[/left]
[left]Sometimes you’re happy.[/left]
[left]Sometimes you’re bored.[/left]
[left]Sometimes you don’t feel like talking to anyone.[/left]
[left]And sometimes… you just need to go home.[/left]
[left][b]Enjoy Moody Farmer![/b][/left]

[left][size=3][b]📦 Requirements[/b][/size][/left]
[left]·       [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/left]
[left]·       [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/left]
[left]·       [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/left]

[left][size=3][b]💡 Compatibility[/b][/size][/left]
[left]Moody Farmer is designed to work alongside other Stardew Valley mods, including large modded playthroughs. [/left]
[left][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.[/left]


[size=3][b]🌱 MY OTHER MODS[/b][/size][size=2][b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52335]Moody Farmer[/url] — Give your farmer a little personality, because not every day is a good day. Wake up with a different mood each morning, with cute icons and gameplay effects that can change how your day unfolds.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52548]Time Chapter[/url] — Give yourself a little breathing room when the day gets busy. Pause the clock, keep playing, and let the next chapter begin when you’re ready.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52511]Soap & Scrub[/url] — Sparkly when clean. Stinky when dirty. A lightweight hygiene system that adds a little extra life to your farmer without turning cleanliness into another meter you have to babysit.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52587]When Nature Calls[/url] — Eat. Drink. Carry Toilet Paper. A lightweight bathroom-need system where nature eventually calls, bathrooms suddenly matter, and waiting too long can turn a normal day into a desperate sprint home.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52632]Oops![/url] — Oops! adds a lightweight skill-based mistake system to Stardew Valley where your farmer actually feels inexperienced when they first arrive in the valley.[/b][/size]

[center][size=1][b]Enjoying these mods?[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=1][b][i]If you like these mods, don't forget to leave an endorsement on Nexus — it really helps and lets me know you're enjoying the mod. ♥[/i][/b][/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: Major v4 update! Adds Excited, Motivated, Confident and Affectionate new moods and a new set of HD icons!

Manifest.Name: Moody Farmer
Manifest.Description: A daily farmer mood system with Positive Moods and Stressed expansions, configurable effects, recovery mechanics, anchored HUD icons, i18n support, and persistent Depression ghosts.
Manifest.Author: ACharles
